data.standardized_narrative: The report does not publish a clear gross prior-year reserve movement figure. The Managing Agent notes that the SPA has material natural catastrophe exposure which adversely affected loss ratios, particularly on the 2017 and 2018 years of account, and specifically references Hurricanes Michael and Florence as contributors to prior-year adverse development. No gross GBP m movement for prior years or an opening gross claims outstanding figure (prior-year comparative) could be reliably extracted from the OCR images available.
raw_causal_phrases: loss ratios particularly impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account
data.data_quality_notes: Images/OCR limited. Could not locate an explicit 'Claims outstanding' gross prior-year opening balance (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2018) in a clearly readable numeric form; Balance Sheet pages were present but values were not unambiguously readable. No explicit GROSS 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was located in the readable text. Narrative references to prior-year adverse impact from Hurricanes Michael and Florence were located (page 3). Gross premium total extracted from segmental/analysis table (appears as $41,552,000 in the images) and reported in native currency (USD) as 41.552 million. Prior-year development (gross) therefore returned as null due to lack of a clear gross quantified source in the provided images. If higher-resolution pages or original PDF text become available a precise gross-opening reserve and PYD figure may be extracted.
